nodes.title: DIN 2024 Accomplishments
nodes.subtitle: Discover DIN's transformative journey in 2024, from scaling to 50+ providers to processing 100M+ daily requests. Explore key milestones in decentralized architecture, partnerships, network growth, and community engagement.

childMarkdownRemark.html:
As we kick off 2025, we’re taking a moment to celebrate everything the Decentralized Infrastructure Network (DIN) achieved in 2024. From welcoming new partners and launching groundbreaking innovations to seeing our network usage soar, it’s been an unforgettable journey. Here’s a look back at the highlights that made 2024 a banner year for DIN.

🚀 Building the DIN community

  • 50+ providers strong: DIN’s community of providers grew rapidly, bringing diverse talents and expertise to the network. Together, we’re building the future of web3 infrastructure!
  • Collaboration in action: Through working group sessions, we tackled key challenges and developed vital components like Routing, Proxy, Payments, and Watchers, setting a strong foundation for what’s next.

🛠️ Innovating DIN’s architecture

  • Decentralized by design: Last year, we transitioned from a federated system to permissionless smart contracts, aligning with our core mission of decentralization.
  • Next-level monitoring: Thanks to CompareNodes, our network monitoring is smarter and more transparent than ever.
  • Security made simple: With EigenLayer, we introduced economic staking and security solutions without needing an initial token launch.
  • Thought leadership: Our whitepaper and litepaper are live at din.build, sharing our vision for decentralized infrastructure with the world.

🌍 Growing the network

  • Unstoppable growth: DIN now handles 100 million daily requests—all via organic growth from our community of developer users!
  • More networks, more possibilities: We integrated routing for 12 networks, making it easier than ever for developers and users to connect.
  • Beta success: Testing with web3 gateways will boost our reach by 10x, which will improve our power of collaboration.

📚 Real-world wins

  • Blast integration: Our first network launch was with Blast Layer 2 and it showcased how DIN enables seamless onboarding and delivers native yield opportunities for developers. The Blast L2 DIN Case study is available for download.
  • MetaMask & Infura: Case studies with these web3 giants as our alpha customers showed how DIN delivers reliable, decentralized infrastructure at scale.

🗓️ Making memories with the community

  • EthDenver, EthCC, and DevCon: DIN made waves at last year’s top web3 events! We connected with developers, shared our latest innovations, and built momentum for the future.
  • Workshops galore: From sticky sessions to brainstorming around high-throughput blockchains, our community came together to innovate and inspire.

🎨 Strengthening DIN’s brand

  • Social media buzz: We launched on platforms like X (Twitter), YouTube, and Mirror.xyz as @DINBuild. If you’re not following us yet, now’s the time!
  • NFT series launched on Phosphor: If you’ve been following us on socials, you’ll know we’ve been quietly launching a series of NFTs on Fridays. Follow us from our Phosphor profile. The DIN as an AVS Announcement NFT has been a hit!
  • Bold new branding: Our fresh look reflects the energy and innovation that make DIN a leader in decentralized infrastructure.

🎉 What’s ahead in 2025

Last year was incredible, and it’s all thanks to you—our providers, partners, and community members. Together, we’ve proven that decentralized infrastructure isn’t just possible—it’s unstoppable.

This year, we’ll keep the momentum going with more networks, advanced features like DIN Payments, and new opportunities to grow our ecosystem. Stay tuned for even more breakthroughs in 2025!

Follow us on X, YouTube, or Mirror.xyz to stay in the loop. Let’s make 2025 even bigger and better—together. 🚀

nodes.title: Swellchain Goes Live: Accessible on Infura, Decentralized by DIN
nodes.subtitle: The restaking-powered Layer 2 network. Swellchain is now live on Infura and decentralized by DIN. Start building scalable, secure, and decentralized DeFi applications with Swellchain’s modular architecture and EigenLayer's pooled security.

image.title: Swellchain Goes Live: Accessible on Infura, Decentralized by DIN Feature Image

childMarkdownRemark.html:
We’re excited to announce that Swellchain, the restaking-powered Layer 2 network, is now live and publicly accessible via Infura and decentralized by DIN! Swellchain represents a transformative leap in Layer 2 technology, combining the security of Ethereum, the scalability of Optimism's OP Stack, and the power of EigenLayer’s pooled restaking mechanism. Whether you’re a developer building DeFi applications or a user seeking the benefits of restaking, Swellchain is designed to deliver.

What makes Swellchain unique?

Swellchain is not just another Layer 2 network. It stands apart through several key innovations:

Restaking-powered security

Swellchain leverages EigenLayer’s restaking mechanism to pool Ethereum’s security across decentralized services, such as sequencing and verification. This eliminates the need for costly custom trust pools, offering robust security while significantly reducing infrastructure overhead.

Native yield through rswETH

Swellchain uses rswETH, a restaked liquid staking token, as its native gas token. This creates a self-reinforcing ecosystem where every transaction contributes to staking rewards, making Swellchain a hub for yield-enhancing DeFi strategies.

Built on the OP stack

By leveraging Optimism’s proven OP Stack, Swellchain inherits a modular, scalable, and Ethereum-compatible foundation, providing developers with a seamless environment to deploy DeFi applications.

Vertically integrated AVS architecture

Swellchain integrates AltLayer’s Actively Validated Services (AVS) to power its core infrastructure:

  • MACH: Rapid finality for near-instant transaction confirmations.
  • VITAL: Permissionless state verification for secure rollup integrity.
  • SQUAD: Decentralized sequencing for censorship-resistant transaction ordering.

These services ensure that Swellchain remains secure, efficient, and decentralized at every layer.

Swellchain, now decentralized by DIN

As a part of the DIN ecosystem, Swellchain is backed by a network of decentralized infrastructure providers. DIN ensures high availability, robust performance, and resilience for all decentralized applications running on Swellchain. This integration aligns with Swellchain’s mission to enhance decentralization while delivering unmatched performance.

  • Infura access via MetaMask developer dashboard:

Developers can now seamlessly connect to Swellchain through Infura’s reliable RPC infrastructure. MetaMask Developer Dashboard integration makes it simple to build scalable and secure DeFi applications.

  • Decentralized by DIN:

Swellchain benefits from DIN’s decentralized infrastructure, ensuring high reliability and performance through a distributed network of providers.

  • Restaking-powered security:

Built on EigenLayer and Symbiotic, Swellchain pools Ethereum’s security for decentralized services, creating a more secure and cost-effective DeFi ecosystem.

Why build on Swellchain?

Swellchain offers developers and users an unmatched platform to build and interact with DeFi applications:

  • Cost-effective transactions:
    Leverage restaking-powered scalability to significantly reduce transaction fees while maintaining Ethereum-grade security.
  • Enhanced yield opportunities:
    With rswETH as the native gas token, every transaction contributes to staking rewards, driving ecosystem growth and user engagement.
  • Seamless interoperability:
    Built on the OP Stack, Swellchain ensures compatibility with Ethereum-based smart contracts and tools, enabling easy migration and integration.

Get started today

Ready to build on Swellchain? Connect via Infura on the MetaMask developer dashboard.

What is DIN?

DIN is a decentralized service discovery marketplace, enhancing the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of dapp development through a network of 50+ Web3 Infrastructure providers.

DIN is capable of serving 14+ popular blockchain network APIs and RPCs with high throughput and performance with no single point of failure. DIN is currently in a federated phase, progressively decentralizing traffic across Infura and MetaMask.

Learn more by reading the DIN Whitepaper.Follow DIN on Twitter/X (DINBuild) and Mirror.

nodes.title: How Collab.Land and MetaMask Are Paving the Way for New Transaction Primitives
nodes.subtitle: Collab.Land and MetaMask’s Delegation Toolkit redefines web3 transactions with smart accounts.

image.title: How Collab.Land and MetaMask Are Paving the Way for New Transaction Primitives

childMarkdownRemark.html:
At Collab.Land, we’re working on an approach that leverages MetaMask’s Delegation Toolkit to redefine how transactions are handled. Delegation using smart accounts offers enhanced flexibility and paves the way for blockchain and AI integration. By enabling partial access to accounts, it creates a secure system where AI agents can perform tasks on behalf of users without compromising account security.

Key concepts like credible commitments and programmable assets are at the heart of this evolution, driving the next wave of innovation. With fine-grained access control, we can precisely define the actions an agent or third party is authorized to perform, making interactions safer and more efficient.

This article explores how this works and what it means for communities, developers, and users.

Smart accounts: rethinking access control

Imagine how a computer allows multiple users to operate under different permission levels—admin rights, guest access, or roles somewhere in between. This concept is fundamental to managing control and security.

In crypto, smart accounts are bringing a similar level of flexibility. They enable precise, on-chain, enforceable delegations, granting others controlled access to our accounts without giving up full authority. This advancement makes credible commitments possible and empowers secure interactions fully aligned with our terms. For a deeper dive into credible commitments, check out this article.

With Externally Owned Accounts (EOAs), which lack granular permissions, we were stuck with an all-or-nothing trust model, making it difficult to achieve fully programmatic credible commitments. With smart accounts and the MetaMask Delegation Toolkit, we can achieve fine-grained access control. This breakthrough allows for fully programmatic credible commitments, enabling precise interactions without compromising security.

The intersection of crypto and AI: introducing RainDrops

The convergence of crypto and AI is not just a possibility—it’s an inevitability. AI agents, acting as assistants, will require partial access to accounts to execute tasks on behalf of users. MetaMask’s Delegation Toolkit, powered by the Delegation framework, provides the controlled programmatic account access that these agents need to function securely and efficiently.

Through a partnership with Lit Protocol, we’ve addressed the challenge of secure, programmatic key access. By integrating Lit Protocol with the Delegation Toolkit, we’ve laid the foundation for seamless AI integration in crypto transactions, unlocking new possibilities for automation and user convenience.

Additionally, we’ve launched a feature called “RainDrops,” which allows recipients to handle gas fees in transactions. This innovative feature introduces a pull-based model, moving away from the traditional push-based approach. With “RainDrops,” we’re redefining transaction mechanics to offer greater flexibility and a user-centric experience, setting a new standard for how transactions are handled in the crypto space.

Next steps

The future isn’t a distant concept—it’s unfolding now. With tools like MetaMask’s Delegation Toolkit and collaborations with innovators like Lit Protocol, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in web3.

For developers, community managers, and crypto enthusiasts, “RainDrops” introduces a transformative pull-based transaction model that empowers recipients to handle gas fees directly. This creates a smoother, more intuitive transaction experience, fundamentally enhancing community interactions and transaction mechanics.

To bring this new transactional flexibility to your community, visit the Collab.Land socials or reach out to our team for integration requests or additional information. Let’s shape the future of seamless Web3 interactions together.

nodes.title: Galxe x MetaMask SDK: Creating a Frictionless Web3 Experience for Users
nodes.subtitle: Learn how Galxe’s integration of MetaMask SDK streamlines wallet connections for a faster, smoother web3 experience.

image.title: Galxe x MetaMask SDK: Creating a Frictionless Web3 Experience for Users

childMarkdownRemark.html:
Galxe is a decentralized super app and the largest onchain distribution platform in web3, offering a suite of products like Quest, Passport, Score, Compass, and Alva. These tools empower users with secure, self-sovereign digital identity management and streamline interactions across blockchain applications, enhancing the overall web3 user experience.

Galxe leverages the MetaMask SDK to elevate the user experience by making wallet connections faster and more reliable for the community. MetaMask SDK enables a reliable, secure, and seamless connection between the Galxe ecosystem and the MetaMask browser extension and mobile app, providing cross-platform compatibility for users.

"Integrating the MetaMask SDK was straightforward and immediately effective. It’s given us a way to enhance the user journey without disrupting user flows, which is a priority for us. The toolkit has been instrumental in achieving smoother, more reliable connections." - Bryce Zhang, Front-End Engineer @ Galxe

Challenge

At Galxe, enhancing user experience is central to our mission. Previously, when users attempted to connect their MetaMask wallet from an inactive state, additional steps were often required, adding unnecessary obstacles. This delay meant users had to wait for the MetaMask app to fully launch and initialize, interrupting their interactions and sometimes resulting in abandoned sessions.

Recognizing these challenges, we sought to develop a solution that offers a seamless connection for users while also enhancing the overall functionality of our platform. By integrating the MetaMask SDK, we aim to streamline the wallet connection process, allowing users to engage with Galxe’s features without cumbersome delays. This integration not only simplifies the user journey but also empowers our platform with advanced functionalities, enabling faster transaction signing and easier identity verification while maintaining a secure environment for our users.

Solution

With the MetaMask SDK integration, we’ve streamlined the login process for Galxe users, providing a faster and more reliable wallet connection experience. In addition to improved connectivity, users can now seamlessly switch between Galxe and MetaMask for essential actions, such as signing transactions and verifying their identities. All interactions occur within a unified interface, making navigation more intuitive and reducing the time and effort typically involved in these processes.

Beyond seamless connections, the MetaMask SDK also strengthens the security of wallet functions within Galxe. Users benefit from advanced security protocols that protect their assets as they engage in quests and interact with blockchain applications. This added layer of security reassures users that their digital assets are well-protected as they explore the decentralized ecosystem.

Together, these enhancements create a frictionless, efficient user journey that connects Galxe and MetaMask into a cohesive, reliable experience. By enhancing both speed and security, we’re delivering a streamlined platform that allows users to focus on exploration and engagement across both Galxe and MetaMask.

For details on how the MetaMask SDK works, learn more here.
